title: Planet view wrapped nodes past the far pole
body: layoutToSphere used min(r,1.999)*pi with LAYOUT_SCALE_FIT=0.72 so farthest nodes had r~1.39 and phi>pi. They wrapped past the antipode onto the near-back and sphereToLayout could not invert. Fixed: FIT=1.08 and clamp phi to [0,pi]. Oracle in tests/frontend/networkVisualiserPlanet.test.js.

title: Planet draw order painted back nodes over front
body: projectPlanetScene wrote nodes in graph index order. A back-facing peer with a later index drew on top of the local node. Fixed: reorder draw buffer by facing (far first). Pick list still front-only. Oracle in networkVisualiserPlanet.test.js draws back-facing nodes before front-facing nodes.

title: Visualiser ignored identity-switched
body: NetworkVisualiser did not listen for identity-switched. Switching identity from the sidebar while on the page kept the previous identity path table, announces, and cachedPositions until a manual refresh. Map/Nomad/Relay already reset. Fixed: clear those fields, empty the WebGL graph, abort in-flight fetches, call update(). Persist snapshots identityHash+rows before await so a mid-write switch cannot save old rows under the new hash.
